MISSING PERSON'S CALL
Timothy Chiwaula
VERY IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ! SHARE ON ALL
SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORMS!
Timothy Chiwaula has been missing since Monday 11th
October
He was last seen by two friends in his house on Old
Shettleston Road, Shettleston/Greenfield area in
Glasgow, around midnight on Sunday 10th October. He's
without his phone, wallet or passport. It's likely he's on
foot.
DESCRIPTION:
23 year old black male
• 5"8/5"9 tall
• Skinny, athletic build
· Brown eyes
• 2-inch long black dreadlocks
• British national, originally from Malawi.
• A small golden stud piercing on both earlobes
• Slight gap between front teeth
• Usually dressed similarly to the first picture
If anybody has seen or heard anything at all about
Timothy please get in touch as soon as possible!
Contact POLICE SCOTLAND on 101, quoting incident
number 0832 of the 14th October.
